g.text: Six physical subtypes within the river hierarchy
The six-class cut is a structural sensitivity, nested within the selected three coarse classes; colour denotes the coarse parent.
Names describe structural medians. All-reach n appears at left; DOC eligibility and response n are recorded in the underlying table.
DOC points are station medians with 95% station-bootstrap intervals. The six-class cut has median subset ARI 0.707, versus 0.329 at three classes.
